abstract.p: Translating sentences between English and Hindi is challenging, especially in the domain of legal documents, due to the specialized legal terminology and the lengthy, complex sentences that often accompany them. In this paper, we fine-tune and compare multiple pretrained multilingual translation models, including the facebook/nllb-200-distilled-1.3B, on a corpus of 50,000 English-Hindi legal sentence pairs provided for the shared task. The training pipeline includes preprocessing, context windows of 512 tokens, and decoding methods to enhance translation quality. The proposed method secured 1 st place on the official leaderboard.
